# PT Maharani Prima

> Fully licensed, ISO-certified Indonesian EPCC contractor — engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning delivered single-source across power, oil & gas and mining. Partner technology (Huawei, Selerys) is delivered as a working plant, wrapped in the full EPCC scope. Established 6 February 2012. Headquartered in Jakarta, with 29 documented site locations across Sumatra, Java, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Maluku, Nusa Tenggara and Bali.

Key facts: 220 wellpads delivered in the Rokan Block · 550 km of HV/MV transmission energized · 9 power plants commissioned · 130 km of pipelines constructed · 3.6 million m³ of earth moved · 5,402,696 safe man-hours without a lost injury. Licenses: SBUJK, SBUJPTL, SKUP Migas, EBTKE. Certifications: ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 37001. Vendor registrations include PLN, Indonesia Power, PJB, Pertamina, PGAS Solution, SKK Migas, Wijaya Karya and Brantas Abipraya.

Mission (verbatim): "To be the world-class EPCC — delivering world-class standards of project planning, management and execution for our clients."
Operating standard: On Schedule. On Budget. On Quality. On Safety.

- [Capabilities](https://maharaniprima.com/capabilities.html): the five EPCC capability lines — mining & hauling, wellpad & earth works, surface facility, HV & MV transmission, power plant.
- [Products](https://maharaniprima.com/products.html): partner technology delivered with full EPCC wrap — Huawei Microgrid Solution, Power POD Truck, Data Center Facility, Fusion Solar; Selerys cloud seeding; the Mahatrax mining intelligence platform.
- [Projects](https://maharaniprima.com/projects.html): the documented project record with clients, locations and scopes, plus HSSE and PMO awards.
- [Insights](https://maharaniprima.com/insights.html): field notes and EPCC fundamentals from the contractor's side of the fence. Atom feed: [feed.xml](https://maharaniprima.com/feed.xml).
- [What an EPCC contractor does](https://maharaniprima.com/insight-epcc-contractor.html): what the EPCC format commits a contractor to, phase by phase, and the checklist for qualifying one.
- [Careers](https://maharaniprima.com/careers.html): vacancies across engineering, HSE and project management.
- [Contact](https://maharaniprima.com/contact.html): inquiry form and office details.
